concerns.text: The plan cites 'MODIS (LST & NDVI)' via the URL 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/nasa-cisto-data-science-group/modis-lake-powell-toy-dataset/...'. This dataset is explicitly a 'Lake Powell toy dataset' (regional, small scale). The project scope (spec.md, FR-007, US-1) requires 'continental-scale' analysis for American Redstart migration across North America. A single-lake dataset cannot provide the spatiotemporal coverage (lat/long extent, 9-year time series) required to model continental migration patterns. The plan acknowledges this mismatch but proposes a 'proof-of-concept' workaround that contradicts the core functional requirement of continental prediction. A valid continental MODIS source (e.g., NASA Earthdata or a verified continental HuggingFace dataset) is required for the plan to be feasible as written.

The plan relies on a 'verified' eBird URL ('https://huggingface.co/datasets/vvud/eb-data/...') but admits in the 'Dataset Fit & Limitations' section that it must 'verify that the specific species Setophaga ruticilla and the years 2015-2023 are present.' If the verified subset lacks the target species or the required temporal range, the entire pipeline (FR-001, FR-003) fails. The plan does not identify an alternative verified source for the full EBD if the provided subset is insufficient, making the project's feasibility contingent on an unverified assumption about the subset's content.
